Buying Pokemon cards from High End Fire

A collector's case, not a warehouse

Each card here is one I sourced, checked over and photographed myself. Most singles are one of one: when a piece sells it moves to the sold archive and something new takes its place.

Raw or graded

Raw cards are listed with a condition such as Mint, Near Mint or Lightly Played, and the photos show the card itself. Graded cards come sealed in a PSA case with the grade and certification number on the label.

Where to start

Browse vintage WOTC-era cards, Japanese cards or sealed booster boxes, or sort this page by price.
